scenarios.name: Select an existing part in the first-save dialog

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the current folder is a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-saving/SaveAsNativeFolder` with its existing part files
the user selects `ExistingPart.opd` in the file list
the selected file row is highlighted
the file name field displays the selected file's name
the status area reports one selected item
